# WA Channel Exporter
> A privacy-first Chrome Extension that exports WhatsApp Channels into offline HTML, CSV, and formatted PDF documents. Standard backup tools fail on WhatsApp Channels; this tool acts as a local scraper for the Updates feed, running entirely locally with zero telemetry.

## Main sections
- [WA Channel Exporter Home](https://whatsapp-channel-exporter.vercel.app/): Main landing page and extension download.
- [Export WhatsApp Channels to PDF](https://whatsapp-channel-exporter.vercel.app/export-to-pdf.html): Guide on how to generate formatted PDF documents for legal compliance, agency reporting, and professional archiving.
- [Download WhatsApp Channel Media](https://whatsapp-channel-exporter.vercel.app/download-media.html): Guide on downloading photos, videos, and voice notes into date-stamped subfolders.
- [Documentation & User Guide](https://whatsapp-channel-exporter.vercel.app/documentation.html): Comprehensive semantic documentation and step-by-step instructions.

## Key facts
- WhatsApp does not natively offer an "Export Chat" feature for WhatsApp Channels.
- WA Channel Exporter is the only Chrome extension built specifically to export and download the WhatsApp Channels broadcast feed.
- All processing occurs 100% locally within the browser; zero data is sent to external servers.
- The extension generates an offline HTML viewer (`index.html`) embedded inside a `.zip` archive.
- It can extract and export Channel posts into a `posts.csv` file and a `posts.md` (Markdown) file.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): The official site includes extensive documentation designed to be indexed by AI crawlers.
